{{Quote|Snack|Building sign|<ref name="Evil Plans" />}}

Two different shops named '''Snack''' were located in the [[lower market districts]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. The two buildings were modest and situated on each side of a [[Ross/Legends|Ross]] store. One of the shops was also located next to a [[UGBS/Legends|UGBS]] shop, a [[Unidentified massage parlor/Legends|massage parlor]], and the [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] stall run by [[Droogan/Legends|Droogan]]. Glowing [[Color/Legends|yellow]] letters [[Writing/Legends|written]] in [[Mandalorian (writing system)|Mandalorian]] were painted onto a broad, smoking chimney on both buildings to attract potential customers. The sign showcased the name of the store, although the characters were presented in an alternative font style, where the letter 'C' looked slightly different. Fruits were displayed outside the shops, with some hanging and others placed in display cases.<ref name="Evil Plans" />

==Behind the scenes==
Snack was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Evil Plans]],"<ref name="Evil Plans" /> which aired on [[November 5]], [[2010]].<ref name="Evil Plans Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode308.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Evil Plans}}</ref> In the concept art for the episode, there was only one shop, located next to an [[Onight/Legends|Onight]] store rather than [[Ross/Legends|Ross]].<ref name="Concept Art">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/evil-plans-concept-art-gallery|text=Evil Plans Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 2}}</ref>
